name: python_if_for
description: Choose Python if versus for keyword for a condition or iteration header; matched control copies the header variable.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0);items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 var=random.choice(['x','y','n','value','item','count']); mode=i%2
 if mode:
  tail=f'{var} in range({random.randint(2,50)}):'; ans='for'
 else:
  tail=f'{var} {random.choice([">", "<", "==", "!=", ">=", "<="])} {random.randint(0,50)}:'; ans='if'
 stem=f'Complete the Python header using if or for.\n___ {tail}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'Missing keyword:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+'Variable name:', 'answer':' '+var})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
